description: Manages user profile information, including personal details and account settings.

endpoints.name: Get
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current user's complete profile information.
example_uses: How can I view my personal profile details?
Show me my current account information.
I need to see my user settings.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when a user wants to view their own profile details, such as name, contact information, or other personal settings.

endpoints.name: UpdateProfile
endpoints.description: Updates the current user's profile information with the provided data.

profile.description: The profile data to update. This typically includes fields like name, email, phone number, etc.

example_uses: I want to change my email address in my profile.
Update my personal details, including my phone number.
Can I modify my user settings?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when a user needs to modify or update any of their personal profile details, such as name, contact information, or preferences.
